[

    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Add a new Symptom",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/1"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {"name": "New Symptom Name"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to the Symptoms addition section.",

    "id": "TC-0mediate",
    "title": "View and Update an existing Symptom's details",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/2"],
    "kind": "positive",

      "No consultation request should be associated with the symptom."

      "Confirmation message for successful update should appear.",
      "Updated symptom details should be retrievable from the list."
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Delete a Symptom",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "negative",

    "inputs": {},

    "title": "Attempt to delete a Symptom with associated consultation requests",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "negative",

      "Click the 'Delete' button."

  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Delete a Symptom with no associated consultation requests",

    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],

      "Symptom should no longer be retrievable from the list."

  {
    "id": "TC-006",

      "Symptom should not be removed from the master list."

    "id": "TC-007",

    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "boundary",

    "steps": [

    ],
    "expected": [
      "An error message should be displayed indicating that the symptom cannot be deleted due to associated consultation requests.",
      "Symptom should not be removed from the master list."
    ]
